hint_ladder: React to surprising news with the two words, and let the speaker keep telling the story.
Say the pair with rising surprise, then repeat a piece of the news as a question.
Start with the words: ___! She actually moved to Lisbon?
teaching_content.reveal_form: No way! She actually moved to Lisbon?
canonical_forms: No way! She actually moved to Lisbon?
alternative_realizations: No way — he ran the whole marathon?
